create_logger: create a Logger instance that writes training logs to a save directory with configurable log level
write_log_message: write a log message at a specified level to both file and stdout using the Logger
log_progress_info: log a dictionary of progress info in simple or JSON format using the Logger
create_tensorboard_logger: create a TensorboardLogger instance that writes scalars and histograms to a log folder
add_scalar_to_tensorboard: add a scalar value to TensorBoard at a given iteration using the TensorboardLogger
